/// A class with a `const` constructor, and an annotation.
class Box {
  const Box(this.items);

  final List<int> items;
}

class Tag {
  const Tag(this.items);

  final List<int> items;
}

/// No test reads its last element: a mutant there survives.
const _limits = [1, 2, 3, 4];

/// A test asks whether it is the same object as an equal constant.
const _a = [10, 20];

/// A test asks that it cannot be changed.
const _m = {'x': 1, 'y': 2};

const _ids = {1, 2, 3};

/// Used where a constant is required.
const _b = [_a];
const _c = _a;
const _two = 2;
const _span = _two * 3 + 1;
const _box = Box(_a);

/// Used by another library of the package, and by a test, in a constant.
const publicLimit = 7;
const publicTable = {'p': 1, 'q': 2};

int limit(int index) => _limits[index];

bool sameAsLiteral() => identical(_a, const [10, 20]);

bool sameConstants() => identical(_b[0], _c);

void change() {
  _m['x'] = 5;
}

void grow() {
  _a.add(30);
}

bool known(int id) => _ids.contains(id);

int look(String key) => _m[key] ?? 0;

@Tag(_a)
int sum({List<int> values = _a}) {
  var total = 0;
  for (final value in values) {
    total += value;
  }
  return total;
}

String kind(int value) {
  switch (value) {
    case _two:
      return 'two';
    case _span:
      return 'span';
    default:
      return 'other';
  }
}

int boxed() => const Box(_a).items.length + _box.items.first;

int nested() => _b.first.last;

class Grid {
  /// Used at runtime only.
  static const sizes = [3, 5, 8];

  static const _unit = 4;

  static int total() {
    var total = 0;
    for (final size in sizes) {
      total += size;
    }
    return total + _unit;
  }
}

int localSum() {
  const steps = [1, 2, 3];
  var total = 0;
  for (final step in steps) {
    total += step * 2;
  }
  return total;
}
